steps.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 16:9 game backdrop. Primary request: A moonlit hay meadow leading to a tall magical glass hill made of layered translucent vellum, a cozy paper barn at far left, winding shining path to the summit, distant friendly village silhouettes, no people, no horses, no apples, no text. Style/medium: premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and felt with visible fibre texture, softly rounded die-cut and scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, occasional tiny stitched details, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers; saturated kraft-paper brights on a warm cream field; child-safe toy proportions and handmade warmth. No text, no letters, no words. Composition/framing: wide 4:3 view with a broad uncluttered lower-centre paper stage and the vellum hill rising along the right edge, keep the centre readable for a child and horse, no important detail under the upper word row. Lighting/mood: deep ink-blue night, copper moonlight and gentle golden points of light, adventurous but never scary. Constraints: environment only; preserve a clear open floor for separately composited sprites. Avoid: characters, creatures, people, food or loose hero objects in the performance area, text, letters, logo, watermark, UI, border, collage, photorealism, 3D.
